Learn how to gain an [[Animal companion]] by [[Charm Animal|charming]] a [[Melandru's Stalker]].  This [[quest]] must be completed to choose [[Ranger]] as a [[secondary profession]].

== Quest information ==

=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = ranger
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Find the shrine of [[Melandru]]'s statue along the path in the woods.
* Use your [[Charm Animal]] skill on one of Melandru's Stalkers when it appears.
* Return to [[Master Ranger Nente]] for your reward.

=== Early benefits ===
* Master Ranger Nente will give you a [[Starter Bow]] and the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill icon|Charm Animal}}
** {{skill icon|Comfort Animal}}
** {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

=== Reward ===
* 250 [[Experience]]

== Walkthrough ==
Head south until you come to a [[Statue of Melandru]].  Near the statue will be a Melandru's Stalker.  Select the stalker and use [[Charm Animal]].  The stalker will become hostile and attack you during this process.  For safety, you may wish to use [[Troll Unguent]] before charming, or you can stand close to the Statue of Melandru which provides [[health regeneration]] to any creature near it.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
; Master Ranger Nente
: ''"One of the great joys in a Ranger's life is earning the trust of an animal companion. If you are interested, I will give you a skill that will allow you to charm an animal. However, it would not be fitting, so close to a shrine of Melandru, to charm just any creature."''

: ''"Along the path here you will find the shrine. Nearby you may find one of the rare cats known by the name Melandru's Stalker. If you can charm one of these animals, you will truly have Melandru's blessing."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am willing.
| decline = No, I have other business.
| ask = Follow the path south to the statue of Melandru. Use your Charm Animal skill on one of the stalkers near the shrine and bring it back to me.
}}

=== If you can no longer receive Charm Animal ===
; Master Ranger Nente
: ''"I can't give you any skills since you've already chosen not to take Ranger as your secondary profession. I think it's unlikely you'll be able to finish this quest."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Master Ranger Nente
: ''"You have done very well; it's not easy to charm one of these great cats. The gods are smiling on you."''

== Notes ==
* If you charm another animal aside from Melandru's Stalker you will not be able to finish this quest but will be able to continue with your chosen pet, unless you give the animal to [[Jarrel the Tamer]], the only [[pet tamer]] in pre-Searing Ascalon. 
* It is a good idea to keep the Melandru's Stalker as the [[post-searing]] quest [[Endangered Species]] requires you to tame one, although you may tame one in post-searing, too.
* If you have the quest [[The Hunter's Horn]] active, the spot you have to purify the horn is near where you charm the Stalker.
